doc_friction.issue: A bare `node --test` in quick-pick-survey and print-atelier also picks up their *.test.ts files (vitest, @/ aliases) under Node 22 type stripping and fails; harmless for CI (run_venture_tests globs *.test.mjs) but a session timing suites by hand is misled. Use run_venture_tests.py <slug>.
The local note says the unwired checks take 'about 90 s'; they took 157 s before this PR and about 95 s after.

goal: Cut the per-job cost of unwired_checks.run_everything() in ventures tests
notes: Metric: wall time of unwired_checks.run_everything() (the phase every ventures-tests job pays after its venture suites). CI before: 133.6 s (run 44639959884) and 165 s (run 44640581736), read from job-log timestamps between the last suite line and the unwired summary. Local before: 157.0 s (4-core container, 6 workers, in-process timer around run_everything with each runner wrapped; summed item time 745.7 s). Local after: 94.3 s and 96.3 s, same method; summed 521.5 s; serial 341.9 s. 265 items, 0 failures before and after. Causes: test_wait_for orphaned sleep holding stdout 30 s; test_friction_rank::test_main_json doing a real git fetch and GitHub API reads. Verification: python3 -m unittest test_wait_for test_unwired_checks OK; pytest test_friction_rank.py 24 passed; check_posts ok; doc_index check ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes DONE exit 0 (6 steps UNRUN: pytest missing locally, or no refs/ci/base-main); PR CI 16 checks green/skipped. Expected CI effect about 60 s per ventures-tests job; recheck ci_profile 'node --test in each touched venture' against 72.5 min / 24 jobs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: CI log reading, per-item bench, two root causes, fixes, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
